ummagga: Ummagga [ud + magga, lit. "off--track"] -- 1. 지하 수로, 겉도랑, 간선 M I.171; A II.189; J VI.426, 432; SnA 50 ("ummaggo paññā pavuccati"); DhA I.252 (°cora); II.37 (v l. umanga); IV.104; PvA 44 (read with v. l. SS kummagga). -- 2. 곁길, 잘못된 길, 우회로 S I.193 (v. l. °manga) = Th 1, 1242; S IV.195; A IV.191.
ummanga: Ummanga [ud + manga (?) or for ummagga, q. v. for vv. ll.] "행운의 외부", 즉, 불운; 혹은 "바른 길에서 멀어진 사람" Vin V.144.
ummatta: Ummatta (adj.) [ud + matta of mad] 제 정신이 아닌, 미친 S V.447 (+ viceta); J V.386; Miln 122; Sdhp 88; PvA 40 (°puggala read with v. l. SS for dummati puggala). Cp. next & ummāda. –rūpa 미친 것처럼, 미친듯이, 정신이상의 Pv I.81; II.62 (where J III.156 has santaramāna).
ummattaka: Ummattaka (adj.) = ummatta; Vin I.123, 321; II.60, 80; III.27, 33; A IV.248; Vism 260 (reason for); Miln 277; PvA 38, 39, 93 (°vesa appearance of a madman), 95. <-> f. ummattikā Vin IV.259, 265; ThA 111.
ummaddeti: Ummaddeti [ud + maddeti, Caus. of mṛd] 뭔가를 ~에 문지르다 (acc.) Vin II.107 = 266 (mukhaṁ).
ummasati: Ummasati [ud + masati of mṛś.] 접촉하다, ~을 잡다, ~을 들어올리다 Vin III.121. Cp. next.
ummasanā: Ummasanā (f.) [abstr. fr. ummasati] 들어올림 Vin III.121 (= uddhaṁ uccāraṇā).
ummā: Ummā (f.) [cp. Sk. umā] 아마, °puppha 결합형에서 (하늘색) 아마의 꽃 M II.13 = A V.61 (v. l. dammā°, ummāta°); D II.260; Th 1, 1068; DhsA 13. Also (m.) 보석의 이름 Miln 118.
ummāda: Ummāda [ud + māda] 광기, 산만함, 정신적 일탈 S I.126 (°ṁ pāpuṇeyya citta--vikkhepaṁ vā); A II.80; III.119; V.169; Pug 69; PvA 6 (°patta 미친 듯이, 제정신이 아닌), 94 (°vāta), 162 (°patta).
ummādanā: Ummādanā (f.) (or °aṁ nt.) [abstr. fr. ummāda] 미치게 하는 Sn 399 (+ mohanaṁ = paraloke ummādanaṁ ihaloke mohanaṁ SnA 377); ThA 2, 357 (cp. ThA 243).
ummāra: Ummāra [according to Muller P. Gr. = Sk. udumbara (?)] <-> 1. 문지방 Vin IV.160 (= indakhīla); Th 2, 410; J I. 62; III.101; Vism 425; DhA I.350. -- 2. 갓돌 J VI.11. -- 3. as uttar° (윗 문지방) 상인방 J I.111; DhA II.5 (v. l. upari°). -- 4. 창틀 J I.347; IV.356. (f.) [for the usual ūmi, cp. similar double forms of bhummi > bhūmi] a wave Th 1, 681; Miln 346.
ummisati: Ummisati [ud + misati] 눈을 뜨다 J III.96 (opp. nimisati; v. l. ummisati for °mīḷ°?).
ummihati: Ummihati [ud + mih] 소변을 보다 Vin I.78 (ūhanati +).
ummīleti: Ummīleti [Caus. of ud + mīl; opp. ni(m)mīleti] 눈을 뜨다 J I.439; II.195; IV.457; VI.185; Miln 179, 357, 394; Vism 185, 186; DhA II.28 (opp. ni°); VvA 205, 314.
ummuka: Ummuka (nt.) [Sk. ulmuka perhaps to Lat. adoleo, cp. also alāta firebrand; see Walde, Lat. Wtb. s. v. adoleo] 횃불 Vin IV.265; S IV.92 (T. ummukka meaning "느슨해진"?); J II.69 v. l. °kk), 404 (kk); III.356.
ummujjati: Ummujjati [ud + majj] 나오다, (물에서) 솟아오르다 Vin I.180; S IV.312; A IV.11 sq; J II.149, 284; III.507; IV.139; Pug 71; Miln 118; DA I.37, 127; PvA 113.
ummujjana: Ummujjana (nt.) [fr. ummujjati] 나옴 Vism 175 (+ nimmujjana); DA I.115.
ummujjamānaka: Ummujjamānaka (adj.) [ummujjamāna, ppr. med, of ummujjati, + ka] 나오는 A II.182.
ummujjā: Ummujjā (f.) [fr. ummujjati] 나옴, (물에서) 뛰쳐오름, ummujja--nimujjaṁ karoti 구절에서, 나와서 & 뛰어들다 D I.78; M I.69; A I.170; J IV.139; Nett 110; Vism 395 (= Ps II.208).
ummūla: Ummūla (adj.) [ud + mūla] "뿌리가-밖으로", 뿌리가 보이게, 뿌리가 다 들어난 J I.249 (°ṁ karoti); Sdhp 452.
ummūlaka: Ummūlaka (adj.) [= ummūla] 뿌리뽑힌, 뿌리가 다 드러난 J I.303 (vāta).
ummūleti: Ummūleti [Caus. fr. ummūla] 뿌리뽑다, 캐내다 J I.329.
umhayati: Umhayati [Sk. *ut--smayate, ud + smi] 큰 소리로 웃다 J II.131 (= hasitaṁ karoti); III.44; IV.197; V.299 (°amāna = hasamāna C.). Caus. umhāpeti J V.297.
